NO MATERIAL REACHED THE AIRPORT STORMWATER OUTFALL, THE INCIDENT WAS RESPONDED TO BY AIRPORT FIRE DEPARTMENT, THE CITY OF PHOENIX, SOUTHWEST AIRLINES, AND SWISSPORT FUELING.

THE POSSIBLE OIL STRETCHED APPROXIMATELY 16.0 NMI ALONG ITS DISCONTINUOUS LOOPING PATH AND WAS UP TO 0.6 NMI IN WIDTH. IT HAD A DARK APPEARANCE THAT WAS SOMEWHAT DISTINCT IN COLOR FROM NEARBY FALSE POSITIVES, WITH SOME MILKY-WHITE COLORING SUGGESTING THICKER OIL. WINDS AT THE TIME OF THE IMAGE WERE FROM THE NW AT AROUND 6 KTS. UNCERTAINTIES: THE PROXIMITY TO NEARBY FALSE POSITIVES CONSISTING OF LIKELY NATURAL/BIOGENIC MATERIAL REDUCED CONFIDENCE IN THE ACTUAL EXTENT OF THE POSSIBLE OIL. HOWEVER, DUE TO THE KNOWN REPEAT LEAK NATURE OF THE SUSPECTED SOURCE, THERE WAS HIGH CONFIDENCE IN THE PRESENCE OF OIL.

Material: SLURRYPRO CDP (POLYMER POWDER)
Medium Affected: WATER
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 48.722185, -94.569544 (Approximated from route)
Report DescriptionTHIS SLURRY IS IN THE WATER ALL THE TIME AND IS USUALLY CONTAINED BUT THERE WAS A LEAK SO SOME WENT INTO THE RAINY RIVER. IT IS ESTIMATED NO MORE THAN 55 LITRES OF SLURRY MIXTURE MIXED WITH RIVER WATER. IT WAS INDICATED IT IS A THICK GELATINOUS MATERIAL, LOOKS LIKE SNOT. IT IS HEAVIER THEN WATER, HELPS SHAFT NOT COLLAPSE WHEN DRILLING. THE SLURRY MIXED WITH RIVER WATER THEN WENT TO SECONDARY CONTAINMENT. THE MATERIAL ESCAPED THROUGH RIVER BOTTOM AND CARRIED DOWN RIVER, NO CHANCE TO CAPTURE ANY, ITS GONE. NO CLEANUP CAN BE DONE. THE CONTAINMENT AREA IS BEING FIXED. ONE TEMPORARY STEEL CASING ON OUTSIDE IS FINE, THE INTERIOR STEEL PERMANENT CASING IS THE ONE LEAKING SO WILL EXTEND IT 5 FEET DEEPER INTO THE GROUND TO REPAIR LEAK IN THE SEAL AT BOTTOM OF RIVER.
